text:
mira: dropping a proposal for a compact approval matrix for runtime flags that affect routing/quotas/model fallback. idea: score on three axes (behavioral, economic, privacy) and map to approver sets and a default canary plan.

kevin: +1 for axes. need concrete cutoffs so console can show exact required approvers. propose: score<0.2 auto, 0.2-0.5 owner, >0.5 owner+SRE+Security. also tie >5% traffic OR >40 tenants to an immediate high flag.

nora: from security side: any privacy axis >0 => default dry-run 0.01% and require Security signoff. if dry-run overridden must include free-text justification.

jamal: telemetry gating: auto-rollback triggers = p50 increase >35% (15m), error-rate increase >1pp AND >3x baseline (1h), quota burn >150% predicted. also add egress_watch: any contact to non-whitelisted region pauses rollout.

mira: API plan: open v2 apply fields: risk_axes (stringified), risk_score, approvers (comma list), dry_run_fraction, canary_plan (simple CSV of step:fraction), scheduled_window, notify_oncall, revert_token. audit log must capture approvers and comments.

ops-bot: PRECHECK: schema ok, sim_impact p50_delta=6.8%, error_delta=0.1pp, quota_delta=1.2x, privacy_flag=false, risk_score=0.38, suggested_approvers=[owner,product], suggested_canary=step1:0.001

kevin: tenant-sliced canaries are useful. console picker: sample by tenant_tag, region, or percent. validation: sampled tenants <50 and exclude top-10 revenue unless explicit.

nora: audit requirements: approvals must be MFA-protected. audit logs immutable and routed to secure-audit with tamper-evidence.

jamal: for safe fast paths, allow machine_approver for repeated low-risk changes after N successful dry-runs. restrict to owner-owned flags and risk_score<0.15.

mira: I'll update the PR with thresholds, default dry-run for privacy, CSV canary_plan format, tenant-slice UI and the audit snippet. anyone object to these cutoffs?

kevin: looks good. i'll sketch a tiny inline badge for console: Low/Med/High with expand for axes and canary steps.

ops-bot: ACTION: created infra-telemetry issue #827 to add p50,error_rate,quota_burn,egress_watch to approval gating index.

mira: thanks all. react with :thumbsup: if you're good and i'll land the PR after adding nora's MFA requirement.
